project.description: Rotation du password MySQL via Vault

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e
echo "=== MySQL Password Rotation Job ===" echo "Started at: $(date)"
export VAULT_ADDR="http://vault:8200"
# ====================== # AppRole Authentication # ====================== if [ -z "$VAULT_ROLE_ID" ] || [ -z "$VAULT_SECRET_ID" ]; then echo "ERROR: VAULT_ROLE_ID et VAULT_SECRET_ID sont requis" exit 1 fi
echo "Authenticating via AppRole..." VAULT_TOKEN=$(vault write -field=token auth/approle/login \ role_id="$VAULT_ROLE_ID" \ secret_id="$VAULT_SECRET_ID") export VAULT_TOKEN echo "AppRole authentication successful"
OLD_PASS=$(vault kv get -field=password secret/mysql) echo "Old password retrieved"
NEW_PASS=$(openssl rand -base64 12) echo "New password generated"
# Change MySQL FIRST (before Vault) mysql --skip-ssl -h mysql -u root -p"$OLD_PASS" <<EOF ALTER USER 'root'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY '$NEW_PASS'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES; EOF
echo "MySQL updated"
# Update Vault only AFTER MySQL succeeds vault kv put secret/mysql \ password="$NEW_PASS" \ username="root" \ host="mysql" \ last_rotation="$(date -Iseconds)" \ rotated_by="jenkins"
echo "Vault updated"
echo "$(date -Iseconds) - Rotation by Jenkins" >> /logs/jenkins-rotations.log
# Log metrics to API curl -s -X POST http://api:5000/metrics/log-rotation \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"path":"mysql","status":"success","source":"jenkins"}'
echo "=== Rotation completed successfully ==="
